# SYS-005: Disks have free space

- **Group:** System
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A full filesystem stops logging, databases and package installs, and fills the places attackers and bugs fill first. Checked: / and /var, and the Docker root (/var/lib/docker) when present. More than 85 percent used warns, more than 95 percent fails.

## Verify by hand

```sh
df -h / /var /var/lib/docker
```

## How to fix it

Prune images and build cache (`docker system prune`), cap logs (LOG-001 to LOG-003) and remove what is not needed.

## What a fix can break

docker system prune removes stopped containers and unused images; confirm what is unused first.

Run `stackward explain SYS-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
